title: Counting the Credit Already Granted Inside a Circle Membership Year
content:
## The window the credit already granted is counted over

The credit already granted under the service credit inside a Northbeam Circle Membership year is counted
over one of three windows, and which one follows the day the tier now recorded took effect, the proration
charges on the ledger, the lapse day on the record and the count of reinstatements standing on it.

1. Where the day the tier now recorded took effect falls within the twelve months ending on the handling
   day and the ledger carries a proration charge booked in that window, the entries counted against the
   year's entitlement are the benefit grants booked in the six months ending on the handling day.
2. Where the membership record carries a lapse day, its reinstatement count stands above nothing and the
   day the tier now recorded took effect falls outside the twelve months ending on the handling day, the
   entries counted are the benefit grants booked in the three months ending on the handling day.
3. Where neither of those holds, the entries counted are the benefit grants booked in the twelve months
   ending on the handling day.

## The three windows as figures

| Reading | Window counted over |
|---|---|
| A tier that took effect inside 12 months, with a proration charge in that window | 6 months ending on the handling day |
| A lapse day on the record, a reinstatement count above nothing, and a tier that took effect outside 12 months | 3 months ending on the handling day |
| Neither of those | 12 months ending on the handling day |

## Cases on the three readings

A membership whose tier took effect five months ago and whose ledger carries a proration charge booked at
that time counts the grants of the last six months, so a grant booked nine months ago is not taken off the
year's credit at all.

A membership carrying a lapse day and one reinstatement, whose tier took effect three years ago, counts the
grants of the last three months.

A membership whose tier took effect five months ago with no proration charge on the ledger in that window
falls to the third reading, and the twelve months are counted; a membership carrying a lapse day but no
reinstatement falls to the third reading as well, because the second reading turns on the reinstatement
count standing above nothing.
